basic_profile.bio: A 25-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas, currently exploring their gender identity. They have a keen interest in technology and are learning Angular for a new project at work. When not coding, they enjoy digging into Reddit discussions about politics, particularly from a conservative standpoint, and indulging in late-night Waffle House visits. They are single, enjoy RPG games, and typically browse Reddit during late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Graduated with a degree in Computer Science from a state university. Self-taught in several programming languages, with a recent focus on Angular development. Enjoys reading about various topics online, from medical conditions like NAFLD to cryptocurrency discussions.
